summary: YY Group Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing board approval of one-time cash performance bonuses totaling $500,000 for two directors for fiscal 2025: $200,000 to Business Development Director Zhang Fan and $300,000 to CEO/Executive Director Fu Xiaowei. The bonuses were paid in cash on June 23, 2026. The filing is a routine compensation decision, not a special situation. No deal terms are present.
